description: Make a finished narrated faceless video (explainer, history, kids story) from one topic: script, scene visuals, AI narration, music bed, stitched export saved to the Library. Phased: create is free and returns a credit quote; produce is charged and advances one step per call (poll every ~30s until it returns the video URL); status is free.

action.description: create (default, free): writes the script and scene plan, returns episode_id and the credit quote. produce (charged): advances production one step (narration, scene renders, music, export, save) and reports what that step cost; call it every ~30s until it returns the finished video URL. status (free): progress only.

category.description: Create step: tone of the script. Default education.

engine.description: Create step (optional): render every scene with one engine. omni-draft: fast, cheap motion preview. omni-final: full quality motion with sound. still-motion: one illustration per scene, gently panned, cheapest. Default: the style picks.

episode_id.description: The episode_id from the create step. Required for produce and status.

length_seconds.description: Create step: target length in seconds. Default 120.

music.description: Create step: add a music bed under the narration. Default true.

style.description: Create step: visual style of every scene. Default editorial-motion.

title.description: Create step (optional): episode title. Defaults to the topic.

topic.description: Create step: what the episode is about, 8 to 400 characters.

voice.description: Create step: narrator voice id from the text-to-speech tool (e.g. Wise_Woman, Deep_Voice_Man, Friendly_Person). Default Wise_Woman.

name: pixeldojo_episode
title: Make faceless video
